incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=autoscaler-queue-clog severity=P0 -> https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

pagerduty: Incident INC12345 created and routed to oncall

Sylvie: acked in PD, I'm on it. seeing spike of queued requests on /generate, latency > 3s and 5xx rising :grimace:

Omar H: looking at infra graph — node utilization 98%, pod pending count increasing, HPA not scaling. Might be hitting max replicas.

Lin: hpa shows target 200, current 200, desired 450. Autoscaler failed to create new nodes: "no capacity" on cloud provider and error 429 on quota calls.

Tia: any recent deploys? I don't see new images in the last 2 hours. Could be traffic spike or eviction churn.

Ravi: checking controller-manager logs now. attaching tail:
```
E 12:07:41 autoscaler-controller: ScaleUp failed: InstanceQuotaExceeded: Not enough quota to satisfy request
E 12:07:42 autoscaler-controller: Retryable error, backoff in effect
E 12:09:01 autoscaler-controller: API rate limit hit while provisioning
```

Sylvie: ok quota + rate limit. We need a manual bypass. Can someone enable emergency-burst for this dedicated pool? That bypasses quota checks for a short window.

Kai (SRE): I can flip emergency-burst but need signoff. Consequences: temporary overcommit billing, but restores capacity within ~90s. Recommend yes given customer impact.

Omar H: +1 from me. Customer-facing endpoints are returning 5xx for ~2% of requests over last 10m and error rate trending up.

Tia: I also see a recurring job that ramped up - internal eval harness - it’s hogging tokens. I’ll pause it after we stabilize.

Sylvie: do it. Tia, post the job id once paused. Kai, please flip emergency-burst and confirm.

Kai (SRE): running command now:
```
# enable emergency burst on pool "dedicated-prod-1"
apictl pools update dedicated-prod-1 --enable-emergency-burst
```

Kai (SRE): command succeeded. Cloud provider provisioning started, 6 instances requested.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: Sylvie acknowledged the incident at 12:10 UTC.

Ravi: cloud provider returning partial success, 4/6 instances active. Remaining 2 in pending because of AZ capacity.

Lin: routing fallback engaged: we’re temporarily spilling new low-priority inference requests to best-effort model variant to reduce pressure. Policy applied: route.priority<=low -> variant=quantized-small

Omar H: error rate dropping to 0.6% now, queue depth trending down. Latency back to ~1s for served requests. Good sign.

Tia: paused internal eval job job-evh-2190. Confirmed stop at 12:13 UTC.

Sylvie: thanks. Who is taking long-form incident lead for postmortem? We should capture root cause (quota/rate limit + burst protection missing) and remediation.

Kai (SRE): I'll own follow-up. Create a ticket with action items: increase reserved quota, add autoscaler better backoff + proactive capacity reservation, alert tuning for PD noise.

Sylvie: PD: marking incident as under control. Leaving note for escalation if errors climb again.

pagerduty: INC12345 acknowledged by Sylvie. Status: Acknowledged -> Under Control

Ravi: running a health sweep across other pools now. No other pools showing same quota errors. Looks localized to dedicated-prod-1 because it hit a hard account quota.

Omar H: quick ask — can we add a temporary rule to reject very large single requests from eval harnesses? That would reduce peak per-request resource usage.

Tia: yep we have throttle endpoints. I’ll open a PR to add size limits and a scheduled job to auto-pause runaway evals if they exceed QPS thresholds.

Kai (SRE): created ticket RI-INC-2026 in backlog: "Quota bump + autoscaler burst policy + eval harness safeguards". Assigning to infra team and PM.

Sylvie: handoff: I'm staying on for 10 more minutes then handing to Kai for follow-up. If errors resurface ping me.

Kai (SRE): OK taking post-incident ownership. Final status: capacity restored, queue drained, customer impact contained. Will run root cause analysis and follow up in #postmortems.

Sylvie: thanks everyone. Summary to paste in PD and customer comms: "Short capacity exhaustion in dedicated-prod-1 due to quota limits + eval job surge; emergency-burst enabled to provision instances; eval job paused; error rates returned to baseline; follow-up ticket created."
